current_official_findings.source: OGC API Features Part 2 CRS by Reference
current_official_findings.verified: Non-default bbox coordinates require bbox-crs; collection metadata must advertise supported CRSs; invalid unsupported bbox-crs must fail with HTTP 400 rather than silently transforming assumptions.

current_official_findings.source: OGC API Features Part 1 Core + Part 3 Filtering
current_official_findings.verified: bbox matching uses geometry intersection; Queryables exposes filterable property names and CQL2 filtering may be used only where declared supported.
Simple point geometry uses x,y with geometryType=esriGeometryPoint; inSR defines input CRS; intersects is the default spatial relation.
Time Stamped DTM is layer 0; service is EPSG:27700 and Query supports JSON. Exact constructed target queries still failed before response bytes in this execution environment.
